text: 金十数据11月7日讯，俄罗斯联邦国家统计局（Rosstat）近日遭遇重大网络攻击，导致部分系统瘫痪。受此影响，俄罗斯多项重要经济报告至少要到11月13日之后才可能发布。Rosstat表示，网络攻击导致其部分基础设施离线，目前仍在持续恢复系统，但没有透露更多细节。该机构周四表示：“为确保数据安全，基础设施的部分区域仍处于隔离状态。这是进行全面检查并分阶段恢复访问权限所必需的。”该机构还称：“因此，网站的部分功能和部分IT基础设施可能暂时无法使用。”尽管Rosstat网站已恢复运行，但企业提交统计报告的截止日期已延长至11月13日。该机构表示，数据收集期限延
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 7 — Russia's Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat) recently suffered a major cyberattack that paralyzed some systems. As a result, several important Russian economic reports may not be released until after November 13 at the earliest. Rosstat said the cyberattack caused parts of its infrastructure to go offline and that it is still restoring systems, without disclosing further details. The agency said on Thursday: "To ensure data security, some areas of the infrastructure remain isolated. This is necessary for a full inspection and phased restoration of access rights." It also said: "Therefore, some functions of the website and some IT infrastructure may be temporarily unavailable." Although the Rosstat website has resumed operation, the deadline for enterprises to submit statistical reports has been extended to November 13.
